# Currents API

Currents News API provides access to the latest news articles from various sources worldwide, supporting multiple languages and categories.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/currents-api/.

## Actions

- **List Latest News** (read-only): Retrieve the latest news articles from Currents News API.
- **Activities Watch** (read-only): Start a notification channel to watch activities for a specified user and application.
- **Get Entity Usage Reports** (read-only): Retrieve usage statistics for a specific Google Workspace entity.
- **Get User Usage Report** (read-only): Retrieve the usage report for a specified user on a given date.
- **List Users** (read-only): List users in a Google Workspace domain.
